Introduction

San is a South Korean singer, dancer, songwriter, and actor under KQ Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ATEEZ which debuted on October 24, 2018 with the mini album "TREASURE EP.1: All to Zero".

In 2021, San made his acting debut in the KBS drama Imitation, portraying Minsoo, a member of the fictional boy group SPARKLING.
